_meta.purpose: Independent verification batch for the ADDRESS recognizer (P1). ALL data is fictional. Written blind to holdout_samples.json, which was not opened while building the recognizer -- the point is to measure coverage of the address CLASS, not of three specific leaked strings.
_meta.composition: 12 samples containing addresses of varied shape; 8 containing SAP jargon and no PII at all, so any redacting span on those is a false positive.
_meta.known_gap: ADDR-12 is a bare ambiguous-type address with no locality ('44 Bellbird Rise'). Option C requires a trailing comma-locality for ambiguous street types, so this is EXPECTED TO MISS. It is included deliberately to keep the cost of that decision visible and measured rather than assumed away.
